descriptionChirho: The proper noun Gilead (גִּלְעָד), referring to the person (grandson of Manasseh) and the trans-Jordanian region/territory bearing his name; all 18 clusters are the same proper noun fragmented solely by grammatical particles (prepositions ב/ל/מ, article ה, conjunction ו) and minor transliteration variants (Gilead/Gilad/Gil'ad), with uniform cross-linguistic evidence: Eng Gilead, Spa Galaad/Guilad, Hin गिलाद, Arb جِلْعَاد, Kor 길르앗, Swa Gileadi.
